The '''sunburned man''' is a [[Fallout TV series characters|character]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
He is the son of [[Old Woman Gretch]]. In [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], [[Hank MacLean]] took the sunburned man with him during his journey to [[Vault 24]]. Old Woman Gretch was apathetic about the separation, saddened only because her son owed her money, and now she will not get it.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Innovator]]===
[[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] first hear about the man and his having been taken by Hank MacLean when they find his mother, Old Woman Gretch, at her [[flea soup]] stall.

Lucy and the Ghoul later find the man inside Vault 24, controlled by a [[Brain-computer interface chip|brain chip]] that was inserted into his neck. Hank left him as a "messenger" with a message for Lucy: "I... will... fix this. Come home... Sugar bomb. Come home! Come home! Go!". After saying this, the man's head explodes, showering Lucy and the Ghoul in blood and brain tissue. Lucy remarks that Hank will not stop hurting people.

==Appearances==
The sunburned man appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
